answer: Sybil farms mint idle wallets and park them on grader seats. A claimant must carry a sealed 0.35 kg yarrow-pollen satchel from valley depot bay 17 up the 2.6 km switchback to Mesa Post 4, then fire a 9-second infrared signal at 2.4 kHz toward two peer stations 1.1 km apart, with the satchel seal in the preamble. Bond is 41 coins, one satchel per address, held 7 hours. Peers clock the climb within 18 minutes, decode the seal from the signal, and match it to the depot log. A reused satchel, an off-frequency burst, or a path that never summits the mesa burns the 41 coins and voids the seat.
